mcqs.question:
With reference to the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026, consider the following statements:
1. It was the 10th edition of the tournament.
2. India defeated New Zealand by 96 runs in the final.
3. The final was played at Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the tournament was the 10th edition, and India defeated New Zealand by 96 runs in the final. Statement 3 is incorrect because the final was held at Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad, not Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai.

mcqs.question: Which team won its first-ever Ranji Trophy title in 2026 by defeating Karnataka at KESA Stadium, Hubballi?
mcqs.explanation: Jammu & Kashmir won their first-ever Ranji Trophy title by defeating Karnataka at KESA Stadium, Hubballi. Karnataka was the defeated finalist, not the winner.

mcqs.question: Who received the Lifetime Achievement Award at the BCCI Annual (Naman) Awards 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Mithali Raj received the Lifetime Achievement Award. Roger Binny and Rahul Dravid jointly received the Col. C.K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award, while Smriti Mandhana was named Best Women's Cricketer.

mcqs.keyword: Fifth award for Best Women's Cricketer
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the BCCI Annual (Naman) Awards 2026 is incorrect?
options: Mithali Raj received the Lifetime Achievement Award.
Shubman Gill won the Polly Umrigar Award for Best International Cricketer.
Smriti Mandhana won the Best Women's Cricketer award for the fourth time.
Shafali Verma won the Best ODI Player award.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is the fourth one: Smriti Mandhana won the Best Women's Cricketer award for the fifth time, not the fourth time. The other three statements correctly identify the respective award winners.

mcqs.question: Who was the runner-up in the men's singles event at the All England Open Badminton 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Lakshya Sen of India was the men's singles runner-up at the All England Open Badminton 2026. Lin Chun-yi of Chinese Taipei won the event, while Tan Ning won the women's doubles title and PV Sindhu withdrew.

mcqs.keyword: Major Dhyan Chand Lifetime Achievement Award
mcqs.question: Who received the Major Dhyan Chand Lifetime Achievement Award at the Hockey India Annual Awards 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Zafar Iqbal received the Major Dhyan Chand Lifetime Achievement Award. Hardik Singh was a Balbir Singh Sr. Player of the Year winner, Prince Deep Singh won the Jugraj Singh Award, and Dilip Tirkey is the President of Hockey India.

mcqs.keyword: World Para Archer of the Year
mcqs.question: Who was named World Para Archer of the Year 2025 by World Archery?
mcqs.explanation: World Archery named Sheetal Devi the World Para Archer of the Year 2025. Greg Easton is the President of World Archery, Andrew Parsons is the President of the IPC, and Preeti Paul won a para-athletics gold at the World Para Athletics Grand Prix.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Mayank Chakraborty became India's 95th Grandmaster.
Statement B: Mayank Chakraborty was the first Grandmaster from Northeast India.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because Mayank Chakraborty became India's 94th Grandmaster, whereas Statement B is true because he was the first Grandmaster from Northeast India. Thus, the correct option is that Statement A is false and Statement B is true.

mcqs.keyword: Player of the Series and Final Player of the Match
mcqs.question: Who were named Player of the Series and Final Player of the Match, respectively, in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Sanju Samson was the Player of the Series, while Jasprit Bumrah was the Final Player of the Match. The other combinations interchange or replace these awardees.

mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes Italy and the venues of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026?
options: Italy qualified for the second time; venues included Ahmedabad, Pune, Chennai, Delhi, Kolkata, Colombo and Kandy
Italy qualified for the first time; venues included Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Chennai, Delhi, Kolkata, Colombo and Kandy
Italy qualified for the first time; venues included Bengaluru, Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Colombo and Kandy
Italy qualified for the first time; venues included Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Chennai, Delhi, Jaipur, Colombo and Kandy
mcqs.explanation: Italy qualified for the tournament for the first time, and the listed venues were Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Chennai, Delhi, Kolkata, Colombo and Kandy. The other options alter either Italy's qualification record or one of the venues.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes Paras Dogra in Jammu & Kashmir's first Ranji Trophy triumph?
options: He was the captain, had played 135 first-class matches, crossed 10,000 Ranji runs and retired from red-ball cricket
He was the vice-captain, had played 153 first-class matches, crossed 10,000 Ranji runs and continued in red-ball cricket
He was the captain, had played 153 first-class matches, crossed 10,000 Ranji runs and retired from red-ball cricket
He was the captain, had played 153 first-class matches, crossed 8,000 Ranji runs and retired from red-ball cricket
mcqs.explanation: Paras Dogra, aged 41, captained Jammu & Kashmir and had 153 first-class matches and more than 10,000 Ranji runs before retiring from red-ball cricket. The alternatives change his role, match tally, run tally or retirement status.

mcqs.question: In which year was the Ranji Trophy established?
mcqs.explanation: The Ranji Trophy was established in 1934. The other years refer to establishment dates of different sports bodies or events in the supplied sports developments.

mcqs.question: Who won the Best Cricketer (domestic) award at the BCCI Annual (Naman) Awards 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Ira Jadhav won the Best Cricketer (domestic) award. Ayush Mhatre and Harsh Dubey received different awards, while Shafali Verma was associated with the Best ODI Player award.

mcqs.question: Which combination of teams was included among the five ICC title-winning teams felicitated at the BCCI Annual (Naman) Awards 2026?
options: The 2026 T20 World Cup men's team, the Women's ODI World Cup team, the Champions Trophy team and the senior Test teams
The 2026 T20 World Cup men's team, the Women's ODI World Cup team, the Asia Cup team and the U-19 teams
The 2026 T20 World Cup women's team, the Women's ODI World Cup team, the Champions Trophy team and the U-19 teams
The 2026 T20 World Cup men's team, the Women's ODI World Cup team, the Champions Trophy team and the U-19 teams
mcqs.explanation: The felicitated teams included the 2026 T20 World Cup men's team, the Women's ODI World Cup team, the Champions Trophy team and U-19 teams. The incorrect options replace one of these listed title-winning groups.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The headquarters of the BCCI is in New Delhi.
Statement B: Mithun Manhas is the President of the BCCI.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because the BCCI headquarters is in Mumbai, whereas Statement B is true because Mithun Manhas is its President. The trap is the changed headquarters city in Statement A.

mcqs.question:
Match the events with their winners at the All England Open Badminton 2026.

List-I
(a) Women's doubles
(b) Mixed doubles

List-II
(i) Ye Hong-wei / Nicole Gonzales Chan
(ii) Liu Shengshu / Tan Ning
(iii) Lin Chun-yi
(iv) Lakshya Sen
mcqs.explanation: Liu Shengshu and Tan Ning won the women's doubles title, while Ye Hong-wei and Nicole Gonzales Chan won the mixed doubles title. Lin Chun-yi and Lakshya Sen were associated with the men's singles result, not these two events.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements regarding the All England Open Badminton 2026 are correct?

1. P.V. Sindhu withdrew from the tournament.
2. The tournament was established in 1899.
3. Winners received 10,000 ranking points.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: P.V. Sindhu withdrew and the tournament was established in 1899. Statement 3 is incorrect because winners received 12,000 ranking points, not 10,000.

mcqs.keyword: Hockey India award winners and prizes
mcqs.question:
Match the Hockey India Annual Awards 2025 categories with the corresponding winners and prizes.

List-I
(a) Balbir Singh Sr. Player of the Year — men
(b) Balbir Singh Sr. Player of the Year — women
(c) Jugraj Singh Award — Men U-21
(d) Best Member Unit

List-II
(i) Jharkhand Hockey Unit — ₹2.5 lakh
(ii) Prince Deep Singh — ₹10 lakh
(iii) Hardik Singh — ₹20 lakh
(iv) Navneet Kaur — ₹20 lakh
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Hardik Singh—₹20 lakh, Navneet Kaur—₹20 lakh, Prince Deep Singh—₹10 lakh and Jharkhand Hockey Unit—₹2.5 lakh. The other options interchange either the awardees, categories or prize amounts.

mcqs.question: At the 2025 World Para Archery Championship in Gwangju, which medal combination did Sheetal Devi achieve?
options: Bronze in individual compound, silver in the women's team event and gold in the mixed team event
Silver in individual compound, gold in the women's team event and bronze in the mixed team event
Gold in individual compound, bronze in the women's team event and silver in the mixed team event
Gold in individual compound, silver in the women's team event and bronze in the mixed team event
mcqs.explanation: Sheetal Devi won gold in individual compound, silver in the women's team event and bronze in the mixed team event at Gwangju. The other options rearrange the three medal colours across the events.

mcqs.question: Who won the Best All-rounder award at the BCCI Annual (Naman) Awards 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Ayush Mhatre won the Best All-rounder award at the BCCI Annual (Naman) Awards 2026. Harsh Dubey won the separate Ranji Trophy Best All-rounder award, while Shubman Gill and Smriti Mandhana received other awards.

mcqs.question: Who received the Ranji Trophy Best All-rounder award at the BCCI Annual (Naman) Awards 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Harsh Dubey received the Ranji Trophy Best All-rounder award at the BCCI Annual (Naman) Awards 2026. Ayush Mhatre won the general Best All-rounder award, while Shafali Verma and Ira Jadhav won the Best ODI Player and Best Cricketer (domestic) awards respectively.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): India topped the World Para Athletics Grand Prix 2026 in New Delhi with 208 medals.
Reason (R): India's medal tally comprised 75 gold, 69 silver and 64 bronze medals.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the assertion and reason are true. The 75 gold, 69 silver and 64 bronze medals together constituted India's total of 208 medals, explaining why India topped the event.

mcqs.question: Which State topped the 24th National Para Athletics Championships at Kalinga Stadium, Bhubaneswar?
mcqs.explanation: Haryana topped the 24th National Para Athletics Championships with 95 medals, including 39 gold. Tamil Nadu won 51 medals and Gujarat won 30, while Jharkhand was not the topper.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the Cycling League of India, consider the following statements:
1. It is India's first franchise road-cycling league.
2. It will have 10 teams.
3. It is scheduled for November 2026.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 3 are correct: the Cycling League of India is India's first franchise road-cycling league and is scheduled for November 2026. Statement 2 is incorrect because the league will have 8 teams, not 10.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II in the context of the Asia Cup Archery 2027 and other archery events in 2026.

List-I
 a. Second leg of Asia Cup Archery 2027
 b. President of the Archery Association of India
 c. Asian Para Archery 2026
 d. South Asian Archery 2026

List-II
 i. Kolkata
 ii. Ahmedabad
 iii. New Delhi
 iv. Arjun Munda
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-iv, c-ii and d-i: the Asia Cup second leg is in New Delhi, Arjun Munda is the AAI President, Asian Para Archery is in Ahmedabad, and South Asian Archery is in Kolkata. The other codes interchange these venues and the office-bearer's name.

mcqs.question: On which date did Indian hockey player Gurjant Singh announce his retirement from international hockey in 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Gurjant Singh retired on 27 March 2026. The other dates alter the month or day and do not match the reported retirement date.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements are correct?
1. India–New Zealand sports ties began in 1926 through an Indian Army hockey tour.
2. India–New Zealand sports ties began in 1926 through an Indian Army football tour.
3. The IOC bars transgender men from women's events.
4. The IOC was established in 1895.
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 1 is correct: India–New Zealand sports ties began in 1926 through an Indian Army hockey tour. Statement 2 changes hockey to football, statement 3 changes transgender women to transgender men, and statement 4 changes the IOC's establishment year from 1894 to 1895.
